items.title: Grok Bot to Begin Using Suno for Music Generation, Musk Says
items.excerpt: Elon Musk says xAI's Grok bot will route music generation to Suno, tapping 'the best back end model for any given task' rather than building its own music model.

items.title: RIAA CEO Talks Midterms, AI Deepfakes and Trump: 'Music Is a Very Bipartisan Issue'
items.excerpt: On Billboard's On the Record, RIAA CEO Mitch Glazier compares Napster and AI and explains why he is confident the NO FAKES Act on AI voice and likeness deepfakes will pass.

items.title: U.S. Copyright Office Opens Music Streaming Fraud Inquiry, Probing Prevalence & 'Potential Solutions'
items.excerpt: The U.S. Copyright Office has launched an inquiry into streaming fraud, including AI-generated tracks pumped with bot streams, seeking input on prevalence and potential solutions.

items.title: Who Actually Made This? The Question AI Is Forcing Music to Ask.
items.excerpt: AI can support music creation, but transparency about human involvement is essential to preserving the meaningful artist-fan connection.

items.title: Tencent Music integrated DeepSeek into its streaming service. Now parent company Tencent is among the biggest backers of the AI company's $12B+ funding round (report)
items.excerpt: DeepSeek has been built into Tencent Music Entertainment's AI songwriting tool, AI assistant and comment sections, as parent Tencent backs the AI lab's new funding round.

items.title: Google picks Base for Music for its Gemini Startup Forum - as $1.7M-backed French company says it uses AI to predict music marketing ROI
items.excerpt: Google selected French startup Base for Music, which uses AI to predict the return on music marketing spend, for its Gemini Startup Forum from over 2,000 applicants.

items.title: Google's new SynthID website can identify AI-generated media
items.excerpt: Google launched a public SynthID Detector site that lets anyone check whether an image, video or audio clip was generated with AI tools from Google, OpenAI, Apple and others.

items.title: 'Frontier Audio AI Company' Modulate Announces $25M Raise
items.excerpt: Voice-intelligence startup Modulate says its AI music detector achieved 95% precision across 76 genres, positioning it as a tool for flagging AI-generated tracks.

items.title: Eleven v4: Our most expressive text-to-speech AI model yet
items.excerpt: Eleven v4 and v4 Turbo bring more emotional nuance, faster responses and stronger voice cloning, live in ElevenAgents, ElevenCreative and the API.

items.title: Fred again.. on AI-generated music: "I'm not worried about the threat of AI"
items.excerpt: Fred again.. criticised AI-made music, saying he has felt 'no pull whatsoever' to use AI tools in his production process.

items.title: [박태용의 뮤직인사이트]⑦ AI는 음악산업의 미래를 어떻게 바꿀 것인가?
items.excerpt: 버추얼 아이돌의 실시간 캐릭터 공연부터 AI 작곡까지, AI가 음악 산업의 제작과 공연, 팬 경험을 어떻게 바꿀지 짚는 연재 마지막 회.

items.title: AI scammers are trying to use me
items.excerpt: Music producer Andrew Huang on AI scammers using his likeness and identity, a creator-side view of AI impersonation in music.

items.title: Fender revamps its website with AI tool and more artist content
items.excerpt: Fender has relaunched its website with a new AI tool for players alongside expanded artist content, extending its push beyond instruments into apps and education.

items.title: HumanCulture bags first clients for its predictive intelligence tech
items.excerpt: HumanCulture, founded by former Defected and AWAL execs, has signed its first clients for AI tech that predicts how music content will perform on social media before posting.
